quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: new production facility (buildings etc.) investment of KRW 18,500 million over 2025.07-2026.07 to raise production capacity, KRW 13,637 million spent (schedule re-adjusted); inventories rose to KRW 25,707 million with work in progress KRW 11,128 million (end-2025 KRW 3,114 million). The company says the AI and data-center driven semiconductor boom has brought over-ordering and price spikes in some parts, so it is building long-term stock and safety stock with suppliers.
quarterly_data.figure: Facility investment KRW 18,500 million (KRW 13,637 million spent); inventories KRW 25,707 million

quarterly_data.signal: Product roadmap and view: GigaVis inspects and repairs L/S 2/2 um patterns; it launched PLP RDL AOI (2025-01) and SSR-V AOR (2025-06) and is developing TGV (through-glass via) inspection, high-resolution WLP and PLP AOI and bump/via 3D AOI. Technology validation is under way in WLP, PLP and glass substrates with chipmakers and OSATs, and the company expects mid- to long-term results from collaboration with a major domestic semiconductor company. The company says AI server/HPC demand from NVIDIA, AMD and Qualcomm is improving substrate makers' results and claims a very high market share in FC-BGA inspection and repair platforms; R&D spend H1 2026 KRW 3,115 million (11.0% of revenue).
